info.name: Factset Analytics Datastore About Documents API
info.description:
Allow clients to fetch precalculated Analytics through predeterministic URLs.

Contact Support:
 Name: FactSet Research Systems
 Email: api@factset.com

request.description: Upload any thrid-party documents that need to be included in the final PDF. Once uploaded, the successful response will be a unique fileurl that can be used to add the files to the PDF output using the create-book endpoint. Supported files include Powerpoint, Word, RTF and PDF. The total size should not exceed 250MB and each file should not exceed 10MB.

response.name: Successful response contains file name, fileURL of the book uploaded

item.name: Factset Returns the Active Calls Happening at the Moment.

query.description: Specifies the  number of results to return per page. [ Min=0; Max=500]
Specifies the starting point for pagination. This parameter is used to identify the beginning of next set of results.

Unique ID for an Internal recording specific to reportID. For example, ReportID X would have multiple recordings from different source (dial-in or webcast). One ReportID can have multiple AudioSourceIDs.
Unique identifier for an event.
Enables to get the data in chronological or reverse chronological order based on startDate. Results are in reverse chronological order if this parameter is not used.
Factset entity level identifier for the company hosting the event.
Ticker-region identifier for the company hosting the event.
Status of the call i.e. ended or inProgress or ewn or issueAtSource.
